people.name: Ephron
people.line: A Hittite who sold a burial site to Abraham.

translations.web: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
translations.bsb: “If you are willing for me to bury my dead,” he said to them, “listen to me, and approach Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf
